basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gaming enthusiast from Portland, Oregon, who works as a software developer by day. I enjoy spending my evenings immersed in the world of Minecraft with my girlfriend, exploring different mods and challenges, like the oneblock skyblock. Aside from gaming, I have a passion for rhythm games, with a particular love for Bemani titles. I often hit the gym, attending Orangetheory classes to keep fit. I'm usually online in the late evenings, around 8 PM to 11 PM PST, after winding down from my workday. In a committed relationship with my girlfriend, who shares my love for gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in computer science with a degree from Oregon State University. My expertise lies in software development, particularly in gaming applications. I have self-taught myself in modding for games like Minecraft. My involvement in communities such as USACO has helped me enhance my problem-solving skills.
